title: Using AI to develop software while being Anti-AI
excerpt: If making software with AI makes you happy then have at it, if it doesn't then don't.
content_html:
If making software with AI makes you happy then have at it, if it doesn't then don't.

If you hate AI and that makes you happy, again, great.

Just don't blindly follow either side of the parroting extreme voices (extreme "ai-pilled" and "doomerist anti-ai") just because they are the loudest voices.

Likely chances are, both of them have a (paid) agenda to push to influence you.
